description: Get ready-to-paste integration code for a form on a given platform. Use 'html' for static sites, 'react' for SPA client components, and 'fetch' (plain fetch with timeout and fallback: Workers, Node, Next, Deno), 'nextjs', 'express', 'python', 'ruby' or 'elixir' when the form already posts to the project's own backend.

api_key.description: Doorman API key (dm_live_...). Only needed if the MCP connection has no Authorization header.
